newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Singapore weekly residue up, distillates also up.
newsitem.headline: Singapore weekly residue up, distillates also up.

text.p: Singapore weekly residue stocks rose by 321,000 barrels in the week ended January 1 to 10.207 million barrels, Singapore's Trade Development Board (TDB) said.
They include HSFO, LSFO, LSWR and the straight-run atmospheric residue, but exclude bitumen.
Middle-distillate stocks rose by 343,000 barrels to 7.466 million barrels. Middle distillates comprise jet, kerosene and gas oil.
Light distillate stocks were up by 651,000 barrels to 5.975 million barrels. They comprise gasoline, reformate and naphtha. -- Singapore newsroom (65-870-3082)
